gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-amiko: Jelly Crazies wobbles along with bowls that nearly seal shut and no calligraphic thinning at all. Amiko, a modern sans, does the opposite job, its outward-pointing terminals keeping every lowercase stroke open and easy to follow.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-anek-gujarat: Anek Gujarati, a plain sans, has lowercase that rivals the capitals and a gaping c opening. Anek Gujarati keeps things approachable while Jelly Crazies wobbles on in its ruler-drawn, constant-width line.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-anek-gurmukh: Wobbly letters up top, open-handed curves below: Jelly Crazies nearly seals its bowls shut, no thinning anywhere. Anek Gurmukhi does the reverse, giving every small letter a big open counter built for steady reading.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-anek-malayal: Jelly Crazies swaps hairline joins for full-width strokes, so its bowls nearly seal shut. Anek Malayalam, a contemporary sans-serif, handles the steady work, its curve tips left open and its lowercase standing close to the capitals.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-anek-telugu: Wobbly, round and nearly sealed: that's Jelly Crazies. Underneath, Anek Telugu brings plain sans bowls, wide and tall and left unlatched, so the wobbling heading gets an open, easy footing.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-armata: Wobbly and nearly sealed, Jelly Crazies draws its bowls almost shut with no thinning anywhere in the line. Armata, a sans, spends its space on open terminals and big lowercase bodies.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-atkinson-hyp: Jelly Crazies traces its letters like outlines in one width, with bowls nearly shut. Atkinson Hyperlegible, a plain sans, reads smoothly paragraph after paragraph, its wide-set s terminals keeping the rhythm loose.

Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono is a sans with open counters that breathe and spacing stretched wide like stencil bridges. While Jelly Crazies wobbles with bowls nearly sealed, the mono text lays out an open row beneath it.
Atkinson Hyperlegible Next reads with lowercase eyes big as washers and rounds left unlatched, like an open hook. Jelly Crazies wobbles above it, its terminals ending as wide as they began.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-chocolate-cl: Chocolate Classical Sans is a plain sans with a sizable lowercase. Its broad-nibbed pen stroke never curls shut, a contrast to Jelly Crazies, whose bowls drawn at stem thickness nearly seal.
